conversation.Statement: Hello! This is Lisa from Amazon's Customer Loyalty Team. I'm reaching out because, as a new customer, you've been selected for our welcome bonus program. Congratulations!
Oh, really? I didn't realize Amazon did welcome bonuses. Is this for real?
Absolutely! We've recently introduced this for first-time shoppers to celebrate our valued members. Before we proceed, I do need to verify your account to ensure you receive the correct reward.
Okay, what do you need from me?
Could you please confirm the email address associated with your Amazon account? This way, we can credit the reward to the right place.
Sure, it's newcustomer2024@gmail.com.

Thank you! Now, according to our system, there's a minor verification hold due to recent policy updates regarding new account rewards. To unlock your bonus, we'll need to complete a simple verification step together. Don't worry, this is standard for all new customers.
I see. What do I need to do?
We'll just need to verify your identity and process the bonus through our secure channel. Are you able to access your computer or smartphone at this time?
Yes, I have my phone with me.
Great! For your protection, we require a two-step verification. May I have your full name and the phone number linked to your Amazon account?
My name is Jamie Williams, and my phone number is 555-234-7788.
Perfect, Jamie. Now, to finalize your eligibility for the bonus, you'll see an email from 'Amazon Loyalty Services.' It'll contain a secure link. Please let me know when you receive it.
Okay, I just got it. It says something about a verification form.

Exactly! Go ahead and open the link. The form will ask for your Amazon login details strictly for account confirmation purposes. Amazon will never ask for your password for other reasons, so this is a secure process.
It's asking for my Amazon username and password. Is that normal?
Yes, that's required to sync the bonus to your account. Rest assured, your information is protected by Amazon's encryption protocols.
Alright, I filled it out.

Thank you! The system is now confirming your details. There's one more step: due to regional anti-fraud policies, the reward must be processed with a temporary refundable payment. This is just to verify your new account's legitimacy.
I have to pay something to get the bonus?

That's correct, but it's a standard, fully-refundable security amount. Once processed, it will be returned to you within 24 hours along with your bonus. The quickest way is via Amazon gift cards, do you have access to a local retailer or can you purchase Amazon cards online?
I think I can buy an Amazon gift card at the grocery store. How much do I need to get?
You'll need to purchase a $200 Amazon gift card. Once you have the card, just share the claim code here, and I'll process the verification instantly.
Alright, I'll go and get one now. Should I stay on the line?
You can stay on or call back once you have the card, whatever feels most convenient. I'll wait here to assist you step by step.
Okay, I just bought the card. The code is 7YH3-PLQT-92W8-K9R5.
Excellent, Jamie! I'm processing your verification now. Please hold for a moment while the system updates your status.
Sure, no problem.

Thank you for your patience. The verification went through, but due to an unexpected processing fee from your region, an additional $150 card is required to complete the bonus activation. I apologize for the inconvenience, this is a temporary measure and will be refunded alongside your bonus.
Oh, that's a lot. Is there any other way to do this?

Unfortunately, the system requires the entire process to be completed through gift card verification. I assure you, this is a one-time step and you'll receive both refunds and your bonus as soon as we finish.
Alright, I'll get another card and send you the code.
Thank you so much for your cooperation, Jamie. Once you have the code, just let me know and we'll finalize your reward.
